svg.title: EM as repeatedly maximizing a lower bound that touches the log-likelihood
svg.desc: A red curve shows the log-likelihood as a function of one parameter, the first component's mean. Three coloured hump-shaped curves are the EM lower bounds built at successive iterates theta0, theta1, theta2. Each lies entirely below the red curve and touches it exactly at the point where it was built; the next iterate is the peak of that bound, so the dots climb the red curve step by step, from theta0 on the far left toward the maximum.
svg.text: ℒ(q⁰, θ): bound built at θ⁰
ℒ(q¹, θ): bound built at θ¹
ℒ(q², θ): bound built at θ²
θ = μ₁, the mean of the first component (the others held fixed)
